leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the `position: fixed` property to create a navigation bar that remains visible while scrolling
Configure a sticky header that transitions from relative to fixed positioning at a specific scroll point
Manipulate the `top`, `bottom`, `left`, and `right` properties to control the placement of fixed elements
Construct a sidebar with sticky positioning that remains within its parent container boundaries
Implement a fixed footer that stays anchored to the viewport bottom regardless of content length
Integrate z-index values with fixed and sticky elements to manage stacking context and visibility
Update element positioning dynamically by toggling between fixed and sticky behaviors based on viewport conditions
